text:
Alaska Nanooks women’s basketball announces 2026-27 season schedule
S. A. Cone
The Alaska Nanooks women's basketball team released its 2026-27 season schedule on Aug. 4, featuring 17 home games at the Alaska Airlines Gymnasium and a November trip to Hawaii for games against Hawaii Hilo, Hawaii Pacific, and Chaminade.
This season's schedule includes several themed nights for fans, such as Jersey Jam and Pajama Night on Nov. 6 and 7 versus Pacific Union, Festive Sweater Night on Dec. 18 against Missouri S&T, Elementary Day on Jan. 9 versus Central Washington, Indigenous Appreciation Day on Jan. 23 against Seattle Pacific, Go Pink with the 'Nooks on Feb. 11 against Western Oregon, 80s Night on Feb. 25 versus Western Washington, and Senior Day on Feb. 27 against Simon Fraser.
Head coach Michael Ricks said, "We're really excited to get this season going. Playing eight home games before Christmas gives us an opportunity to build momentum in front of our fans. The trip to Hawaii will be a special experience for our team and a chance to grow together early in the season. It's a schedule that challenges us in the right ways, and we believe it will prepare us well for conference play."
The Nanooks begin their campaign at home with two games against Pacific Union Pioneers on Nov. 6 and Nov. 7 before heading south for three matchups in Hawaii starting Nov. 10 through Nov. 14. Upon returning to Fairbanks they face Stanton University Elks twice during the Mt. McKinley Bank North Star Invitational from Nov. 18 through Nov. 20, concluding the tournament with Northwest University on Nov. 22.
After preparing for Great Northwest Athletic Conference play during an off weekend, Alaska starts GNAC competition with road games at Simon Fraser (Dec. 3) and Western Washington (Dec. 5), followed by three more home contests before year-end including two matches with Northwest Indian College (Dec. 14 & Dec. 15) and one non-conference game vs. Missouri S&T (Dec. 18). The new year opens away at rival Alaska Anchorage (Jan. 2), then continues with alternating stretches of home stands—including rivalry matchups—and road trips until concluding regular-season play at home versus Western Washington (Feb. 25) and Simon Fraser (Feb. 27).
The full schedule is available online.
